verdict_archaeology: Bronze has ONE pin-and-slot stage, not a cascade. The multi-stage chain examined here (G_k1 -> f_eps -> G_k2 -> f_eps) is NOT instantiated by the bronze. The bronze's harmonic content is dominated by the single pin-and-slot equation-of-centre at k=l (mean anomaly), plus second-order sin(2 l) at amplitude eps^2 ~ 0.003 rad ~ 600 arcsec. No higher harmonics from cascade. So the 'every-cross-combination' claim does NOT apply to the bronze — there are no cross-stage products to combine.
